children: The crypto market moved lower overall, with the Meme sector down 3.77% over 24 hours and SocialFi the only comparatively resilient sector. According to Odaily, SoSoValue data showed Pepe (PEPE) fell 16.97%, Useless Coin (USELESS) declined 7.86% and Bonk (BONK) dropped 4.90%. CeFi fell 0.25%, while Cronos (CRO) rose 3.60%; Layer 1 declined 0.88%, with NEAR Protocol (NEAR) down 1.99%; PayFi fell 1.17%, while Zcash (ZEC) dropped 3.38%; DeFi declined 2.43%, with Uniswap (UNI) down 9.41%; and Layer 2 fell 2.95%, while Arbitrum (ARB) dropped 8.63%. SocialFi gained 4.50%, with Gram (GRAM) up 5.56%. Historical sector indices showed ssiSocialFi rose 4.74%, while ssiMeme fell 4.23% and ssiRWA declined 3.91%.

title: Crypto Market Falls Broadly, Meme Sector Drops Nearly 4% as SocialFi Holds Firm
